# Encounters: the Lake Road (route `lake-rd`, Bellwether → Lake Vellum) and the lake-wood
<!-- Roll 1d12 per hour on the road or in the wood. Encounter lines are scaled at play. -->

| roll | result |
|------|--------|
| 1–4 | Pipes on the wind, faint then louder; a reel; anyone who has heard it before finds their feet keeping time |
| 5 | A fisherman walking the other way with a frozen fish under his arm, singing the reel; he does not know where he is going and is pleased about it |
| 6 | ENCOUNTER easy "snowball sprites": sprite ×n (ambush from the birches with snow; they want to know if you can dance; they vanish giggling if you can) |
| 7 | A cask in a drift, Patient Brewers' mark, half empty, warm to the touch |
| 8 | ENCOUNTER medium "a stray satyr": satyr ×1 (dancing alone, lost from the ring; he begs you to walk him back, dancing, which is slower) |
| 9 | Hoofprints and goose prints together, leaving the road for the goat path to the ridge (DC 12 to notice the path) |
| 10 | The ice sings as the temperature drops: a long high note across the lake; Fahrenheit would want to know about it |
| 11 | ENCOUNTER hard "the wolves at the ice": wolf ×n (ordinary wolves, circling a satyr who has fallen; the satyr is still dancing, prone) |
| 12 | Princess Ysolde, "Issy, a stable hand", on a borrowed horse, going the same way; she has heard the pipes too and wants a look |
